Customers whose tier is "wholesale" are resellers with a resale certificate, so invoices for them must never include tax, even when the customer's region has a tax rate.

**Why:** Accountant's rule — resellers hold a resale certificate, so they are tax-exempt.

**How to apply:** When writing or changing invoice/tax calculation code, treat tier == "wholesale" as an override that sets tax to zero before any region-based rate is applied. Add a test covering a wholesale customer in a taxed region. No code change was requested yet (as of 2026-11-26).
